handson_farm_charm.jam.dump: Empty pot — a cooking batch will be discarded
handson_farm_charm.board.cut: Use a knife or cleaver to cut along the dashed marks
handson_farm_charm.board.knife: Place a knife here to chop; remove it to assemble dishes
handson_farm_charm.lid: Click the lid to open or close. Cooking requires a closed lid
handson_farm_charm.crank: Take the crank and turn the mouse in circles
handson_farm_charm.fire: Left-click: light the stove. Right-click: extinguish
handson_farm_charm.help: Click the handle, stir in circles. Click again to release. Esc: leave.
handson_farm_charm.stir: Hold or click the spoon handle and move the mouse in circles
handson_farm_charm.available: Click to add the missing ingredients for one recipe
handson_farm_charm.unavailable: Ingredients missing or station cannot fit this recipe
handson_farm_charm.fill_failed: Cannot add this recipe: check ingredients, free space and the lid.
handson_farm_charm.serving_failed: A matching serving container and free inventory space are required
handson_farm_charm.pot_contents: Add ingredients. Click food to take it; right-click the soup with an empty cursor to recover a poured ingredient.
handson_farm_charm.whisk: Hold or click the whisk and move the mouse in circles
handson_farm_charm.serving: Click: serve one into inventory. Shift: serve a batch. A matching vessel is required.
